key_facts: The decision concerns Driver Gabriel Bortoleto in Car 5, racing for Audi Revolut F1 Team at the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix.
During the race, Car 5 moved under braking as it approached Turn 5 and collided with Car 43, forcing Car 43 to leave the track.
This action breached Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code, which prohibits moving under braking in a way that affects other cars.
The Stewards issued a Warning (also called a black/white flag) to Driver Bortoleto.
plain_explanation:
At the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix, Driver Gabriel Bortoleto in Car 5 moved to the side while braking as he approached Turn 5 and hit Car 43, pushing that car off the track.

The rule says drivers cannot move under braking in a way that touches or affects other drivers. Moving under braking like this removes a driver's control and makes the car unpredictable to others.

The Stewards gave Bortoleto a Warning. In FIA rules, a Warning (which is the same as a black/white flag) tells a driver to stop the behaviour. A second offence of the same kind can lead to a stronger penalty.
